eyebrow: A gold table IS a cache
code:
CREATE TABLE gold.daily_revenue AS
SELECT order_date, SUM(total_amount) AS daily_total
FROM FactOrders GROUP BY order_date;
-- aggregation runs once; every read after is cheap
caption: Pre-aggregation is caching, just under a different name.

code:
Pre-aggregation:    a KNOWN question, computed ahead of time
Result-set cache:   the LAST query's answer, reused if it repeats
caption: Different problems -- known questions vs. ad hoc ones.

code:
Gold refreshed 6 hours ago.
Is the cached dashboard answer still correct, or now stale?
-- storing it was easy; knowing WHEN it's stale is not
caption: Never invalidating = confidently wrong forever.

subtitle: The next real constraint a design has to absorb.
